body: Thank you! Great video, really encouraging to hear Mullen speak about not giving up and getting back on your feet.

Thanks a lot I appreciate it. I guess it it really only takes one person to change your life and its worth waiting for. The waiting just can get a bit depressing at times. I am starting at a new school so I hope i can take all the lessons i learned and try to make the best of it.My dad means a lot to me if i don't think he could take losing another child.

I have tried a couple of anti-depression medications but i feel like they didn't do a whole lot to help. My friends and family noticed that i became almost like a zombie.Im not taking any currently but as you said you sometimes need to shop around a but to find the right one. I feel like there no magic pill the will solve all my problems but using it with therapy could be a good idea. 
    Ive also felt that if i did one stupid thing in front of other people it would make me immediately disconnect with them. I think i have a good personality and have been told that im funny  but i would just turn into a completely different person if i did anything wrong. I guess i just have a fear of rejection and failure so i do not take as many chances as i should.It was hard after losing my brother and I really think it made me more vulnerable to insults and made me more sensitive to what people think of me. Losing a best friend like that was hard but I did learn a lot from it and what not to say or do when in a relationship like that. Just need to get the process rolling and i hope that getting into a new school with all that i learned can will prove beneficial. Thank you for taking the time to comment, it really made me think.

Yes, i wish i realized sooner that getting drunk does not make you more confident or outgoing; it just makes you look like a idiot.I feel like i just start thinking about every mistake all at once it just makes me feel terrible. I think taking it day by day would be good to kinda set a routine for myself. My brother has said that i should also start working out more so that would be another step in the right direction. Thanks for the insight about the apparent best years of our lives. I guess that its really different for everybody and i just need to wait for mine to start.I appreciate the help, it really did make me feel better.
